## What it is

One flat file per rule area, per Shopware major: `<version>/be-code-guidelines.md`,
`<version>/code-guidelines.md`, and so on.

## How to navigate

Read `guidelines/<version>/<file>.md` through the `guidelines/` view to get the effective
file (platform rules merged with any project rules), never this directory's files directly.
